lateran-v-1513: Fifth Lateran Council, session 8 (19 December 1513), on the human soul (the decree known as Apostolici regiminis), English translation read at papalencyclicals.net
jw-what-is-soul: Watch Tower Bible and Tract Society, "What Is a Soul?" (Bible Questions Answered), read at jw.org
pentecost-introit: The Introit of Pentecost Sunday, Spíritus Dómini replévit orbem terrárum (Wisdom 1:7), in the Missale Romanum (1962 rubrics), Latin text as published by the Divinum Officium project (divinumofficium.com)
rashi-genesis: Rashi (Rabbi Shlomo Yitzhaki, died 1105), commentary on Genesis, trans. M. Rosenbaum and A. M. Silbermann (1929-1934), read at sefaria.org
oca-vespers-readings: Orthodox Church in America, daily Scripture readings (oca.org/readings), the Vespers readings for the Forty Martyrs of Sebaste (9 March: Wisdom 3:1-9 and 5:15-6:3), the Great Martyr George (23 April: Wisdom 3:1-9 and 4:7-15) and St Nicholas (6 December: Wisdom 4:7-15), read for 2026
